notes.text: Available in cPanel 74 and later. Retrieves per-account NVData using a required JSON object body on direct cPanel UAPI only. names is an optional nonnullable string list; omission, an empty list, empty strings, duplicates and ordering are preserved without inferring server defaults. NVData keys and values have documented limits of 128 and 2048 bytes; the client adds no byte or format checks.

The formal response is an object with an optional personalization map, although the pinned data example uses direct keys. Preserve the formal wrapper and optional reason, native integer success 0/1 and nullable string value fields. A row success of 0 is returned data under envelope status 1; envelope status 0 is an API error. Keep names, values and upstream reasons private; do not log mismatch payloads or fetch returned values.

The separate 2026-11-01 protocol probe on 11.138.0.19 observed only structural personalization rows in a bare direct-UAPI envelope. Its temporary parser incorrectly read result.status/data, so the retained api_or_http_failure classification is a probe error and establishes no API outcome, row identity, successful live typed coverage or missing-key semantics. No implicit read, retry or fallback is added. Personalization/set remains excluded under 8x0.29.6.

evidence.note: The pinned x-readonly=true operation has a required application/json object request body and optional names array of strings. Select source POST with existing direct-only JSON metadata; apply no request corrections.
